farraa:125-125.t: His words: ﴿أَتَدْعُونَ بَعْلاً﴾: They mentioned that it was an idol of gold called Baʿl, so He said ﴿أَتَدْعُونَ بَعْلاً﴾, i.e. [do you call upon] this idol as a lord? And it is said: do you call upon a baʿl as a lord other than Allah? And it is mentioned of Ibn ʿAbbās that a stray animal was being announced, and its owner came and said: "I am its baʿl." Ibn ʿAbbās said: "This is Allah's word ﴿أَتَدْعُونَ بَعْلاً﴾", i.e. a lord.

farraa:126-126.t: His words: ﴿ٱللَّهَ رَبَّكُمْ وَرَبَّ آبَآئِكُمُ ٱلأَوَّلِينَ﴾ is read in the accusative and the nominative. Al-Rabīʿ ibn Khaytham read it in the accusative.

farraa:130-130.t:
His words: ﴿سَلاَمٌ عَلَىٰ إِلْ يَاسِينَ﴾: He gave it a nūn. The Arabs sometimes do this with foreign names. They say: Mīkāl, Mīkāʾīl, Mīkāʾil and Mīkāʾīn with a nūn. It is found among the Banū Asad, who say: "This is Ismāʿīn who has come", with a nūn, while the rest of the Arabs [say it] with a lām. He said: and one of the Banū Numayr recited to me about a lizard (ḍabb) that one of them had caught:
يقول أهلُ السوق لما جينا * هذا وَربِّ البيت إسرائينا
(The people of the market said when we came: "By the Lord of the House, this is Isrāʾīn!")
So this is one explanation of His saying Ilyāsīn. And if you wish, you may take Ilyāsīn as a plural, making his companions included in his name, as you say of a people whose chief is al-Muhallab: "al-Mahāliba and al-Muhallabūn have come to you"; so it would be like the saying al-Ashʿarīn, al-Saʿdīn and the like. The poet said:
* أنا ابن سعدٍ سَيّدِ السَّعْدِينا *
(I am the son of Saʿd, chief of the Saʿds.)
And this is more frequent with two: that one is combined with his companion when he is more famous by name; as the poet says:
جزانى الزَّهدمان جزاء سَوءٍ * وكنتُ المرءَ يُجزَى بالكرامَهْ
(The two Zahdams repaid me with an evil repayment, while I was a man who used to be repaid with honour.)
and the name of one of them was Zahdam. Another said:
جزى الله فيهَا الأعوَرَين ذَمَامَةً * وفروة ثَغْر الثورَةِ المتضَاجِم
(May Allah repay the two one-eyed men for it with blame, and Farwa, the crooked-mouthed one of the uprising.)
and the name of one of them was Aʿwar.
Some read ﴿وَإنّ اليَأْسَ﴾, making his name Yaʾs and adding the alif and lām to it. Then they read ﴿سَلاَمٌ عَلَىٰ آل يَاسِينَ﴾; in the commentary of al-Kalbī the explanation came of "upon the family of Yāsīn" as: upon the family of Muḥammad, peace and blessings of Allah be upon him. The first is closer to being correct — and Allah knows best — because in the reading of / 160 ب ʿAbdallāh it is ﴿وَإِنَّ إِدْرِيسَ لَمِنَ المرسَلينَ﴾ ﴿سَلاَمٌ عَلى إِدْراسِين﴾. And His words ﴿وَشَجَرَةً تُخْرُجُ مِنْ طُورِ سَيْنَاءَ﴾ bear witness to the correctness of this; then He said in another place ﴿وَطُورِ سِينِينَ﴾, and it is one meaning and one place. And Allah knows best.

farraa:140-140.t: His words: ﴿ٱلْفُلْكِ ٱلْمَشْحُونِ﴾: when a ship is equipped and filled, this name applies to it. al-fulk is treated as masculine and feminine and is also taken as a plural; Allah said ﴿حَتَّى إذَا كُنْتُمْ فِى الفُلْكِ وَجَرَيْنَ بِهِمْ﴾, making it a plural. It is like al-ṭifl ("child"), which is singular and plural; and al-ḍayf ("guest") and al-bashar ("mankind") are similar.

farraa:141-141.t: His words: ﴿ٱلْمُدْحَضِينَ﴾: the defeated. One says: adḥaḍa Allāhu ḥujjataka fa-daḥaḍat ("Allah refuted your argument, so it collapsed"). Its original sense is a man slipping.

farraa:142-142.t: His words: ﴿وَهُوَ مُلِيمٌ﴾: he is one who has earned blame even if he has not been blamed. al-malūm is one who has actually been blamed with the tongue. It is like the Arabs' saying aṣbaḥta muḥmiqan muʿṭishan, i.e. you have foolishness and thirst [around you]. This is frequent in speech.

farraa:146-146.t: His words: ﴿مِّن يَقْطِينٍ﴾: it was said in the presence of Ibn ʿAbbās: "It is the leaf of the gourd." He said: "And what made the gourd leaf, among all plants, yaqṭīn? Every leaf that is broad and gives cover is yaqṭīn."

farraa:147-147.t: His words: ﴿وَأَرْسَلْنَاهُ إِلَىٰ مِئَةِ أَلْفٍ أَوْ يَزِيدُونَ﴾: aw here is in the sense of bal ("rather"). So it is in the commentary, while also being sound in Arabic.

farraa:148-148.t: His words: ﴿فَمَتَّعْنَاهُمْ إِلَىٰ حِينٍ﴾: in the reading of ʿAbdallāh (فمتّعناهم حَتَّى حِين). ḥattā and ilā are the same in [expressing] limits when used with nouns.

farraa:149-149.t: His words: ﴿فَٱسْتَفْتِهِمْ﴾, i.e. ask them — ask the people of Mecca.

farraa:152-153.t: His words: ﴿لَكَاذِبُونَ﴾ ﴿أَصْطَفَى﴾ is a question containing a rebuke to them. The interrogative alif is sometimes dropped from a rebuke. Similar is His saying ﴿أَذْهَبْتُمْ طَيِّبَاتِكُمْ﴾, which is read both with and without the interrogative, and the meaning of both is one. And the alif of (اصْطفى), when it is not interrogative, drops in connected speech, and you begin it with kasra.

farraa:158-158.t: His words: ﴿وَجَعَلُواْ بَيْنَهُ وَبَيْنَ ٱلْجِنَّةِ نَسَباً﴾: it is said that al-jinna here are the angels. They set up a kinship between Him and His creation. ﴿وَلَقَدْ عَلِمَتِ ٱلجِنَّةُ﴾ that those who said this ﴿مُحْضَرُونَ﴾ — [will be brought] into the Fire.

farraa:161-161.t: His words: ﴿فَإِنَّكُمْ وَمَا تَعْبُدُونَ﴾: He means: and your gods which you worship ﴿مَا أَنْتُمْ عَلَيْهِ بِفَاتِنِينَ﴾: [you are not] leading astray.

farraa:162-162.t: His words: ﴿مَآ أَنتُمْ عَلَيْهِ﴾, i.e. you are not leading [anyone] astray upon that religion. And His words ﴿عَلَيه﴾, ﴿بِهِ﴾ and ﴿لَهُ﴾ are equivalent here. The people of Najd say: bi-muftinīna. The people of the Hijaz [say]: fatantu al-rajul, while the people of Najd say: aftantuhu.

farraa:163-163.t:
His words: ﴿إِلاَّ مَنْ هُوَ صَالِ ٱلْجَحِيمِ﴾: except one for whom it was decreed, in Allah's prior knowledge, that he would burn in Hell. Al-Ḥasan read (إلاَّ مَنْ هو صَالُ الجحيم), with ḍamma on the lām, according to what they have mentioned. If he meant a singular, it is not permissible, because you do not say hādhā qāḍun nor rāmun. But if he knew a metathesized form (lugha maqlūba) in it, like ʿātha and ʿathā, then it is correct. The Arabs have said: jurufun hārun and hārin, and huwa shāku al-silāḥ 161 ا and shākī al-silāḥ ("bristling with weapons"). One of them recited to me:
فلو أَنَّى رميتك من بَعيد * لعَاقكَ عن دعاء الذئبِ عَاقِى
(Had I shot at you from afar, a hindrance would have kept you from calling the wolf.)
He means ʿāʾiq; this is one of the metathesized forms. And from it are ﴿ولاَ تَعْثوا﴾ and wa-lā taʿīthū — two dialect forms. It may also be that you make ﴿صَالو﴾ a plural; as you say: "Among the men are those who (man huwa) are your brothers", taking huwa to refer to the unspecified noun, and putting its verb in the plural; as the poet said:
إذا ما حَاتم وُجد ابن عمّى * مَجَدنَا مَن تكلّم أجمعينَا
(When Ḥātim is found to be my cousin, we surpass in glory all who speak.)
and he did not say takallamū. The best in Arabic, when you bring out the pronoun reference (kināya), is to bring it out according to the meaning and the number, because you intend the reality of the noun.

farraa:164-164.t:
His words: ﴿وَمَا مِنَّآ إِلاَّ لَهُ مَقَامٌ مَّعْلُومٌ﴾: this is the speech of the angels, up to His words ﴿وَإِنَّا لَنَحْنُ المسَبِّحُونَ﴾; He means ﴿المصَلُّونَ﴾ ("those who pray"). In the reading of ʿAbdallāh: (وإن كُلَّنا لمَّا له مقام معلوم).
And in [Sūrat] Maryam: ﴿إنْ كُلُّ مَنْ فِى السّمَوَاتِ وَالأَرْضِ لَمَّا أَتَى الرَّحْمَنَ عَبْداً﴾. The meaning of in ḍarabtu la-Zaydan is like the meaning of your saying: mā ḍarabtu illā Zaydan ("I struck no one but Zayd"); that is why I mentioned this.

farraa:167-167.t: His words: ﴿وَإِن كَانُواْ لَيَقُولُونَ﴾: He means the people of Mecca: ﴿لَوْ أَنَّ عِنْدَنَا ذِكْراً مِنَ الأَوَّلينَ﴾; He says: a scripture or prophethood; ﴿لَكُنَّا عِبَادَ اللهِ المُخْلَصِينَ﴾.

farraa:170-170.t: Allah said: ﴿فَكَفَرُواْ بِهِ﴾. The meaning is: Muḥammad had been sent to them with the Quran, and they disbelieved in it. This is implied, not mentioned, because its meaning is known; like His words ﴿يُرِيدُ أَنْ يُخْرِجَكُمْ مِنْ أَرْضِكُمْ﴾, then He said ﴿فمَاذَا تَأْمُرُونَ﴾, joining Pharaoh's speech to their speech because the meaning is clear.

farraa:171-171.t:
His words: ﴿وَلَقَدْ سَبَقَتْ كَلِمَتُنَا لِعِبَادِنَا﴾: those for whom felicity was preordained. In the reading of ʿAbdallāh it is (ولقد سبقت كلمتنا عَلى عبادنا المرسَلين). ʿAlā is acceptable in the place of the lām, because their meanings come back to one thing. It is as if the meaning were: it was made due upon them and for them; as He said ﴿عَلَى مُلْكِ سُلَيْمَان﴾, whose meaning is: during (fī) the reign of Solomon. So just as it was permitted to alternate between fī and ʿalā when the meaning agrees, so it was done with this.
His words: ﴿فإذَا نَزَل بِسَاحَتِهِمْ﴾: its meaning is: upon them. The Arabs make do with "the courtyard" (al-sāḥa) and "the vicinity" (al-ʿaqwa) for the people themselves.
Their meaning is one: "the punishment descended upon you" and "upon your courtyard" are the same.
His words: ﴿فسَاءَ صَبَاحُ المُنْذَرِينَ﴾: He means: evil is the morning of… In the reading of ʿAbdallāh: ﴿فبئس صَبَاح المُنْذِرِين﴾. And in the reading of ʿAbdallāh: "I have announced to you with the announcement of the messengers, you will surely be asked about this great tiding." It was said to him: "It is only 'and I announced to you'", and he said: "This is how it is with me."

muyesser-irab:1-1.t: ﴿والصافات صفا﴾: the wāw is a particle of oath and genitive; «الصافات» is genitive (majrūr) by the wāw of oath, and the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted verb, its implied form being "I swear" (أقسم); «صفًا» is an emphasising mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object).

muyesser-irab:2-2.t: ﴿فالزاجرات زجرا﴾: the fāʾ is a conjunction, «الزاجرات» is conjoined to «الصافات», and «زجرا» is a mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object).

muyesser-irab:3-3.t: ﴿فالتاليات ذكرا﴾: the fāʾ is a conjunction; «التاليات» is conjoined to what is sworn by in the preceding ayahs; «ذكرًا» stands in place of the mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object), because it is in the meaning of «التاليات», or it is the mafʿūl bihi (direct object) of «التاليات».

muyesser-irab:4-4.t: ﴿إن إلهكم لواحد﴾: «إن» is an abrogating particle (ḥarf nāsikh), «إلهكم» is its noun, the lām is the shifted lām (al-lām al-muzaḥlaqa), and «واحد» is its khabar (predicate); the clause has no grammatical position, because it is the answer to the oath.

muyesser-irab:5-5.t: ﴿رب السماوات والأرض وما بينهما ورب المشارق﴾: «رب السماوات» is a badal (substitute) from «واحد», or a second khabar (predicate), or the khabar of an omitted mubtadaʾ (subject); «ما» is conjoined to «السماوات»; «بينهما» is an adverb attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun, and the ṣila clause has no grammatical position. «رب المشارق» is conjoined to «رب السماوات».

muyesser-irab:6-6.t: ﴿إنا زينا السماء الدنيا بزينة الكواكب﴾: speech that is resumptive, with no grammatical position; «إن» is an abrogating particle (ḥarf nāsikh), «نا» is its noun; «زينا» is a past verb, «نا» is the fāʿil (agent), «السماء» is the mafʿūl bihi (direct object), and the clause «زينا» is the khabar (predicate) of «إن»; «الدنيا» is a naʿt (adjective); «بزينة» is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to (mutaʿalliq) «زينا»; and «الكواكب» is a ʿaṭf bayān (explicative apposition), or a badal (substitute), of «زينة».

muyesser-irab:7-7.t: ﴿وحفظا من كل شيطان مارد﴾: the wāw is a conjunction; «حفظا» is a mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object) of an omitted verb, the implied form being "and We guarded it with a guarding" (حفظناها حفظًا); «من كل شيطان» is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to (mutaʿalliq) the omitted verb; «مارد» is a naʿt (adjective) of «شيطان».

muyesser-irab:8-8.t: ﴿لا يسمعون إلى الملأ الأعلى ويقذفون من كل جانب﴾: «لا» is negating; «يسمعون» is an imperfect verb, nominative (marfūʿ), the sign of its nominative being the retention of the nūn, and the wāw is the fāʿil (agent); «إلى الملأ الأعلى» is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to (mutaʿalliq) «يسمعون»; «الأعلى» is a naʿt (adjective) of «الملأ»; «يقذفون»: the wāw is a conjunction, and «يقذفون» is an imperfect verb built for that whose agent is not named (passive), the wāw being the nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent); «من كل جانب» is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to «يقذفون».

muyesser-irab:9-9.t: ﴿دحورا ولهم عذاب واصب﴾: «دحورًا» is a mafʿūl li-ajlihi (object of purpose), i.e. "they are pelted for repulsion" (يقذفون للدحور); or a ḥāl (circumstantial), i.e. "repulsed" (مدحورين); or it stands in place of the mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object), because it has the meaning of the maṣdar (verbal noun); the wāw is a conjunction; «لهم» is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted fronted khabar (predicate); «عذاب» is a delayed mubtadaʾ (subject); and «واصب» is a naʿt (adjective) of «عذاب».

muyesser-irab:10-10.t: ﴿إلا من خطف الخطفة فأتبعه شهاب ثاقب﴾: «إلا» is a particle of restriction (ḥaṣr) and exception; «مَن» is in the position of a nominative (marfūʿ) as a badal (substitute) from the wāw in «يسمعون», or in the position of an accusative (manṣūb) as the excepted; «خطف» is a past verb, its fāʿil (agent) latent (mustatir), its implied form being "he" (هو); «الخطفة» stands in place of the mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object), accusative; «فأتبعه»: the fāʾ is a conjunction, «أتبعه» is a past verb, and the hāʾ is a fronted mafʿūl bihi (direct object); «شهاب» is a delayed fāʿil; and «ثاقب» is a naʿt (adjective) of «شهاب».

muyesser-irab:11-11.t:
﴿فاستفتهم أهم أشد خلقا أم من خلقنا﴾: the fāʾ is the fāʾ al-faṣīḥa (signalling an implied condition); «استفتهم» is an imperative verb, indeclinable (mabnī) on the dropping of the weak letter, its fāʿil (agent) necessarily latent (mustatir), its implied form being "you" (أنت), and the hāʾ is the mafʿūl bihi (direct object); the hamza is interrogative; «هم» is a mubtadaʾ (subject), «أشد» is the khabar (predicate), and «خلقًا» is a tamyīz (specification); «أم» is a conjunction, and it is connected (muttaṣila); «من» is conjoined to «هم»; the clause «خلقنا» is a verb, with «نا» as the fāʿil, and it is the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun, with no grammatical position.
﴿إنا خلقناهم من طين لازب﴾: «إن» is an abrogating particle (ḥarf nāsikh), «نا» is its noun, «هم» is the mafʿūl bihi, and the clause «خلقناهم» is the khabar of «إن»; «من طين» is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to (mutaʿalliq) «خلقناهم»; and «لازب» is a naʿt (adjective) of «طين».

muyesser-irab:12-12.t: ﴿بل عجبت ويسخرون﴾: «بل» is a particle of transitional digression (iḍrāb intiqālī); «عجبت» is a past verb, the tāʾ is the fāʿil (agent), and the attached element (mutaʿalliq) is omitted, i.e. "at the power of Allah over these mighty creations"; «ويسخرون»: the wāw is circumstantial (ḥāliyya), «يسخرون» is an imperfect verb, and the wāw is the fāʿil; the clause «يسخرون» is the khabar (predicate) of an omitted mubtadaʾ (subject), i.e. "while they mock" (وهم يسخرون), and the clause is accusative (manṣūb) as a ḥāl (circumstantial).

muyesser-irab:13-13.t: ﴿وإذا ذكروا لا يذكرون﴾: the wāw is a conjunction; «إذا» is an adverb of the future including the meaning of condition; the clause «ذكروا» is in the position of a genitive (majrūr) because the adverb is annexed to it; «ذكروا» is a past verb built for that whose agent is not named (passive), the wāw being the nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent); «لا» is negating; «يذكرون» is an imperfect verb, nominative (marfūʿ), the wāw being the fāʿil (agent); the clause «لا يذكرون» has no grammatical position, because it is the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ) of a non-jussive condition.

muyesser-irab:14-14.t: ﴿وإذا رأوا آية يستسخرون﴾: the wāw is a conjunction; «إذا» is an adverb of the future including the meaning of condition; «رأوا آية» is a verb, fāʿil (agent) and mafʿūl bihi (direct object); the clause «رأوا» is in the position of a genitive (majrūr) because the adverb is annexed to it; «يستسخرون» is an imperfect verb, nominative (marfūʿ) by the retention of the nūn, the wāw being the fāʿil; the clause «يستسخرون» has no grammatical position, because it is the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ) of a non-jussive condition.

muyesser-irab:15-15.t: ﴿وقالوا إن هذا إلا سحر مبين﴾: the wāw is a conjunction; «قالوا» is a past verb, and the wāw is the fāʿil (agent); «إن» is negating; «هذا» is a mubtadaʾ (subject); «إلا» is a particle of restriction (ḥaṣr); «سحر» is the khabar (predicate) of «هذا»; «مبين» is a naʿt (adjective); and the clause is the object of the saying (maqūl al-qawl).

muyesser-irab:16-16.t: ﴿أئذا متنا وكنا ترابا وعظاما أئنا لمبعوثون﴾: the clause is likewise the object of an omitted verb of saying, i.e. "and they said, denying the resurrection"; the hamza is for the rhetorical question of disapproval (istifhām inkārī); «إذا» is an adverb of the future including the meaning of condition; the clause «متنا» is in the position of a genitive (majrūr) because the adverb is annexed to it, being a past verb with «نا» as the fāʿil (agent); «كنا» is an incomplete (nāqiṣ), abrogating past verb, «نا» is its noun, «ترابًا» is its khabar (predicate), and «عظامًا» is conjoined to «ترابًا»; the hamza is likewise for the rhetorical question of disapproval; «إن» is an abrogating particle (ḥarf nāsikh), «نا» is its noun, the lām is the shifted lām (al-lām al-muzaḥlaqa), and «مبعوثون» is its khabar.

muyesser-irab:17-17.t: ﴿أوآباؤنا الأولون﴾: the hamza is interrogative, and the wāw is a conjunction; «آباؤنا» is conjoined to the position of «إن» and its noun, or to the pronoun in «مبعوثون»; or «آباؤنا» is a mubtadaʾ (subject) whose khabar (predicate) is omitted, the implied form being "and our forefathers too will be resurrected?" (أوآباؤنا يبعثون أيضًا); «الأولون» is a naʿt (adjective).

muyesser-irab:18-18.t: ﴿قل نعم وأنتم داخرون﴾: «قل» is an imperative verb, its fāʿil (agent) a latent (mustatir) pronoun, its implied form being "you" (أنت); «نعم» is a particle of answer; the wāw is circumstantial (ḥāliyya); «أنتم» is a mubtadaʾ (subject) and «داخرون» the khabar (predicate); the clause «وأنتم داخرون» is accusative (manṣūb) as a ḥāl (circumstantial), its governor being «نعم» in view of its meaning, i.e. "yes, you will be resurrected, humbled" (نعم تبعثون داخرين).

muyesser-irab:19-19.t: ﴿فإنما هي زجرة واحدة فإذا هم ينظرون﴾: the fāʾ is the fāʾ al-faṣīḥa (signalling an implied condition); «إنما» is a restraining and restrained (kāffa wa-makfūfa) [particle]; «هي» is a mubtadaʾ (subject), «زجرة» is the khabar (predicate), and «واحدة» is a naʿt (adjective); the fāʾ is a conjunction; «إذا» is of surprise (fujāʾiyya); «هم» is a mubtadaʾ; «ينظرون» is an imperfect verb, nominative (marfūʿ), the wāw being the fāʿil (agent); the clause «ينظرون» is the khabar, and it is an imperfect verb with the wāw as fāʿil.

muyesser-irab:20-20.t:
﴿وقالوا يا ويلنا﴾: the wāw is resumptive; «قالوا» is a past verb, the wāw being the fāʿil (agent); «يا» is a particle of drawing attention, or the one addressed (munādā) is omitted; «ويلنا» is the one addressed, muḍāf, accusative (manṣūb). The clause «وقالوا يا ويلنا» is resumptive, with no grammatical position.
﴿هذا يوم الدين﴾: «هذا» is a mubtadaʾ (subject), and «يوم الدين» is the khabar (predicate).

muyesser-irab:21-21.t: ﴿هذا يوم الفصل الذي كنتم به تكذبون﴾: «هذا» is a mubtadaʾ (subject), «يوم الفصل» is the khabar (predicate), and «الذي» is a naʿt (adjective) of «يوم»; «كنتم»: «كان» is an incomplete (nāqiṣ) past verb, and the tāʾ is its noun; «به» is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to (mutaʿalliq) «تكذبون»; «تكذبون» is an imperfect verb, nominative (marfūʿ), the wāw being the fāʿil (agent); the clause «تكذبون» is the khabar of «كان»; the clause is resumptive, with no grammatical position, or it is the completion of their saying, and His words «تكذبون» are a shift (iltifāt) from the first person to the second-person address.

muyesser-irab:22-22.t: ﴿احشروا الذين ظلموا وأزواجهم وما كانوا يعبدون﴾: «احشروا» is an imperative verb, indeclinable (mabnī) on the dropping of the nūn, and the wāw is the fāʿil (agent); «الذين» is the mafʿūl bihi (direct object). «ظلموا» is a past verb, the wāw being the fāʿil, and the clause «ظلموا» is the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun, with no grammatical position. «أزواجهم» is conjoined to the relative noun, or a mafʿūl maʿahu (object of accompaniment); «ما» is a relative noun, likewise conjoined, or a mafʿūl maʿahu; «كانوا»: «كان» is an incomplete (nāqiṣ), abrogating verb, the wāw is its noun, and the clause «يعبدون» is its khabar (predicate), being an imperfect verb, nominative (marfūʿ), the wāw being the fāʿil.

muyesser-irab:23-23.t: ﴿من دون الله فاهدوهم إلى صراط الجحيم﴾: «من دون الله» is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial); the fāʾ is a conjunction; «اهدوهم» is an imperative verb, the wāw is the fāʿil (agent), and «هم» is the mafʿūl bihi (direct object); «إلى صراط الجحيم» is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to «اهدوهم».

muyesser-irab:24-24.t: ﴿وقفوهم إنهم مسئولون﴾: «قفوهم» is conjoined to what came before; it is an imperative verb, indeclinable (mabnī) on the dropping of the nūn, the wāw is the fāʿil (agent), and «هم» is the mafʿūl bihi (direct object); «إنهم»: «إن» is an abrogating particle (ḥarf nāsikh), «هم» is its noun, and «مسئولون» is its khabar (predicate); the clause gives the reason (taʿlīl) for the command.

muyesser-irab:25-25.t: ﴿ما لكم لا تناصرون﴾: the clause is the object of an omitted verb of saying, i.e. "and it will be said to them in rebuke"; «ما» is an interrogative noun, a mubtadaʾ (subject); «لكم» is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted khabar (predicate); «لا» is negating; «تناصرون» is an imperfect verb, nominative (marfūʿ) by the retention of the nūn, the wāw being the fāʿil (agent); the clause «لا تناصرون» is circumstantial (ḥāliyya).

muyesser-irab:26-26.t: ﴿بل هم اليوم مستسلمون﴾: «بل» is a particle of digression (iḍrāb); «هم» is a mubtadaʾ (subject); «اليوم» is an adverb attached to (mutaʿalliq) «مستسلمون»; and «مستسلمون» is the khabar (predicate) of «هم».

muyesser-irab:27-27.t: ﴿وأقبل بعضهم على بعض يتساءلون﴾: the wāw is resumptive; «أقبل» is a past verb, «بعضهم» is the fāʿil (agent), «على بعض» is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to (mutaʿalliq) «أقبل», and «يتساءلون» is an imperfect verb, the wāw being the fāʿil; the clause «يتساءلون» is circumstantial (ḥāliyya), and the clause «وأقبل بعضهم على بعض» is resumptive, with no grammatical position.

muyesser-irab:28-28.t: ﴿قالوا إنكم كنتم تأتوننا عن اليمين﴾: «قالوا» is a verb and its fāʿil (agent); «إنكم»: «إن» is an abrogating particle (ḥarf nāsikh), and the kāf is its noun; «كنتم»: «كان» is an incomplete (nāqiṣ) past verb, the tāʾ is its noun, and the clause «تأتوننا» is its khabar (predicate); «تأتوننا» is an imperfect verb, the wāw is the fāʿil, and «نا» is the mafʿūl bihi (direct object); the clause «كنتم» is the khabar of «إن»; «عن اليمين» is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial) from the fāʿil of «تأتوننا».

muyesser-irab:29-29.t: ﴿قالوا بل لم تكونوا مؤمنين﴾: «قالوا» is a verb and its fāʿil (agent); «بل» is a cancelling digression (iḍrāb ibṭālī); «لم» is a particle of negation, conversion [to the past] and jussive; «تكونوا» is an imperfect verb, jussive (majzūm) by «لم», the wāw is its noun, and «مؤمنين» is its khabar (predicate).

muyesser-irab:30-30.t:
﴿وما كان لنا عليكم من سلطان﴾: «ما» is negating; «كان» is an incomplete (nāqiṣ), abrogating past verb; «لنا» is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to (mutaʿalliq) its omitted fronted khabar (predicate); «عليكم» is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial); «من» is a connective (ṣila) preposition; and «سلطان» is genitive (majrūr) in form and the noun of «كان» in position.
﴿بل كنتم قوما طاغين﴾: «بل» is likewise a cancelling digression (iḍrāb ibṭālī); «كنتم»: «كان» is an incomplete past verb, the tāʾ is its noun, «قومًا» is its khabar, and «طاغين» is a naʿt (adjective) of «قومًا».

muyesser-irab:31-31.t: ﴿فحق علينا قول ربنا إنا لذائقون﴾: the fāʾ is a conjunction; «حق» is a past verb; «علينا» is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to (mutaʿalliq) «حق»; «قول ربنا» is the fāʿil (agent); «إنا»: «إن» is an abrogating particle (ḥarf nāsikh) and «نا» is its noun; the lām is the shifted lām (al-lām al-muzaḥlaqa), and «ذائقون» is its khabar (predicate); the nominal clause gives the reason (taʿlīl) for what came before; the object of «ذائقون» is omitted, i.e. "the punishment" (العذاب), and the fāʿil is latent (mustatir), its implied form being "we" (نحن).

muyesser-irab:32-32.t: ﴿فأغويناكم إنا كنا غاوين﴾: the fāʾ is a conjunction; «أغويناكم» is a past verb, «نا» is the fāʿil (agent), and the kāf is the mafʿūl bihi (direct object); «إنا»: «إن» is an abrogating particle (ḥarf nāsikh) and «نا» is its noun; «كنا»: «كان» is an incomplete (nāqiṣ), abrogating past verb, «نا» is its noun, and «غاوين» is its khabar (predicate); the clause «كنا» is the khabar of «إن».

muyesser-irab:33-33.t: ﴿فإنهم يومئذ في العذاب مشتركون﴾: the fāʾ is the fāʾ al-faṣīḥa (signalling an implied condition); «إن» is an abrogating particle (ḥarf nāsikh) and «هم» is its noun; «يومئذ»: «يوم» is an adverb of time attached to (mutaʿalliq) «مشتركون», and «إذٍ» is a noun indeclinable (mabnī) on an implied sukūn, because the place is occupied by the tanwīn of compensation, in the position of a genitive (majrūr) as muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct); the tanwīn compensates for a clause, the implied form being "on the day when they question one another" (يوم إذ يتساءلون); «في العذاب» is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to «مشتركون»; and «مشتركون» is the khabar (predicate) of «إن».

muyesser-irab:34-34.t: ﴿إنا كذلك نفعل بالمجرمين﴾: «إن» is an abrogating particle (ḥarf nāsikh) and «نا» is its noun; «كذلك»: the kāf is a noun meaning "like" (مثل), indeclinable (mabnī) on fatḥa, in the position of an accusative (manṣūb) as a naʿt (adjective) of an omitted maṣdar (verbal noun) placed before its governor; «ذلك»: «ذا» is a demonstrative in the position of a genitive (majrūr) as muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct), the lām is for distance, and the kāf is a particle of address; «نفعل» is an imperfect verb whose fāʿil (agent) is latent (mustatir), and the clause «نفعل» is the khabar (predicate) of «إنا»; «بالمجرمين» is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to (mutaʿalliq) «نفعل».

muyesser-irab:35-35.t: ﴿إنهم كانوا إذا قيل لهم لا إله إلا الله يستكبرون﴾: «إن» is an abrogating particle (ḥarf nāsikh) and «هم» is its noun; «كان» is an incomplete (nāqiṣ), abrogating past verb, the wāw is its noun, and the clause «كانوا» is the khabar (predicate) of «إن»; «إذا» is an adverb of the future including the meaning of condition; «قيل» is a past verb built for that whose agent is not named (passive), its nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent) latent (mustatir), its implied form being "it" (هو); the clause «قيل» is in the position of a genitive (majrūr) by annexation; «لهم» is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to (mutaʿalliq) «قيل»; «لا» is the lā of generic negation, «إله» is its noun, indeclinable (mabnī) on fatḥa, «إلا» is a particle of restriction (ḥaṣr), and «الله» is a badal (substitute) from the position of «لا» and its noun; the clause «لا إله إلا الله» is the object of an omitted verb of saying, i.e. "say: there is no god but Allah" (قولوا: لا إله إلا الله); «يستكبرون» is an imperfect verb, nominative (marfūʿ), the wāw being the fāʿil (agent), and the clause «يستكبرون» is the khabar of «كانوا»; the apodosis (jawāb) of «إذا» is omitted, indicated by what precedes it.

muyesser-irab:36-36.t: ﴿ويقولون أئنا لتاركوا آلهتنا لشاعر مجنون﴾: «يقولون» is conjoined to «يستكبرون»; the hamza is for the rhetorical question of disapproval (istifhām inkārī); «إن» is an abrogating particle (ḥarf nāsikh), «نا» is its noun, the lām is the shifted lām (al-lām al-muzaḥlaqa), and «تاركو» is the khabar (predicate) of «إن»; «لشاعر» is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to (mutaʿalliq) «تاركو», i.e. "for the sake of a poet" (لأجل شاعر); and «مجنون» is a naʿt (adjective).

muyesser-irab:37-37.t: ﴿بل جاء بالحق وصدق المرسلين﴾: «بل» is a cancelling digression (iḍrāb ibṭālī); «جاء» is a past verb whose fāʿil (agent) is latent (mustatir); «بالحق» is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to (mutaʿalliq) «جاء»; «صدق» is a past verb whose fāʿil is latent; «المرسلين» is the mafʿūl bihi (direct object); and «صدق المرسلين» is conjoined to «جاء بالحق».

muyesser-irab:38-38.t: ﴿إنكم لذائقو العذاب الأليم﴾: «إن» is an abrogating particle (ḥarf nāsikh), the kāf is its noun, the lām is the shifted lām (al-lām al-muzaḥlaqa), «ذائقو» is the khabar (predicate) of «إن», «العذاب» is muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct), and «الأليم» is a naʿt (adjective).

muyesser-irab:39-39.t: ﴿وما تجزون إلا ما كنتم تعملون﴾: the wāw is a conjunction; «ما» is negating; «تجزون» is an imperfect verb built for that whose agent is not named (passive), the wāw being the nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent); «إلا» is a particle of restriction (ḥaṣr); «ما» is a second mafʿūl bihi (direct object), with a muḍāf omitted, i.e. "the recompense of what" (جزاء ما); «كنتم» is an incomplete (nāqiṣ) past verb, the tāʾ is its noun, and the clause «تعملون» is its khabar (predicate); «تعملون» is an imperfect verb, nominative (marfūʿ), the wāw being the fāʿil (agent); the clause «كنتم تعملون» is the ṣila (relative clause) of «ما», with no grammatical position.

muyesser-irab:40-40.t: ﴿إلا عباد الله المخلصين﴾: «إلا» is a particle of exception meaning "but" (لكن), because the exception is disconnected (munqaṭiʿ); «عباد الله» is excepted from the wāw in «تجزون»; and «المخلصين» is a naʿt (adjective) of «عباد الله».

muyesser-irab:41-41.t: ﴿أولئك لهم رزق معلوم﴾: speech that is resumptive, with no grammatical position; «أولئك» is a mubtadaʾ (subject); «لهم» is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted fronted khabar (predicate); «رزق» is a delayed mubtadaʾ; «معلوم» is a naʿt (adjective) of «رزق», and its nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent) is latent (mustatir); the clause «لهم رزق معلوم» is the khabar of the first mubtadaʾ «أولئك».

muyesser-irab:42-42.t: ﴿فواكه وهم مكرمون﴾: «فواكه» is a badal (substitute) from, or a ʿaṭf bayān (explicative apposition) of, «رزق»; the wāw is a conjunction or circumstantial (ḥāliyya); «هم» is a mubtadaʾ (subject), and «مكرمون» is the khabar (predicate).

muyesser-irab:43-43.t: ﴿في جنات النعيم﴾: «في جنات» is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to (mutaʿalliq) «مكرمون», or attached to an omitted second khabar (predicate) of «هم» in the preceding ayah, or attached to an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial).

muyesser-irab:44-44.t: ﴿على سرر متقابلين﴾: «على سرر» is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to (mutaʿalliq) «متقابلين», and «متقابلين» is a ḥāl (circumstantial); or «على سرر» is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to an omitted ḥāl as well.

muyesser-irab:45-45.t: ﴿يطاف عليهم بكأس من معين﴾: «يطاف» is an imperfect verb built for that whose agent is not named (passive); «عليهم» is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent); «بكأس» is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to «يطاف»; «من معين» is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to an omitted naʿt (adjective) of «كأس»; the clause is a naʿt of «مكرمون», or a ḥāl (circumstantial) from the pronoun in «متقابلين», or a resumptive clause with no grammatical position.

muyesser-irab:46-46.t: ﴿بيضاء لذة للشاربين﴾: «بيضاء» is a second naʿt (adjective) of «كأس», «لذة» is a third naʿt of «كأس», and «للشاربين» is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to (mutaʿalliq) «لذة».

muyesser-irab:47-47.t:
﴿لا فيها غول﴾: the clause is a fourth naʿt (adjective) of «كأس»; «لا» is negating; «فيها» is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted fronted khabar (predicate); and «غول» is a delayed mubtadaʾ (subject).
﴿ولا هم عنها ينزفون﴾: the wāw is a conjunction; «لا» is negating; «هم» is a mubtadaʾ; «عنها» is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to «ينزفون»; «ينزفون» is an imperfect verb built for that whose agent is not named (passive), the wāw being the nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent); and the clause «ينزفون» is the khabar of «هم».

muyesser-irab:48-48.t: ﴿وعندهم قاصرات الطرف عين﴾: the wāw is a conjunction; «عندهم» is an adverb attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted fronted khabar (predicate); «قاصرات الطرف» is a delayed mubtadaʾ (subject); «الطرف» is muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct), nominative (marfūʿ) in position if «قاصرات» is regarded as a resembling adjective (ṣifa mushabbaha), or accusative (manṣūb) in position if «قاصرات» is regarded as an active participle; and «عين» is a naʿt (adjective) of «قاصرات الطرف».

muyesser-irab:49-49.t: ﴿كأنهن بيض مكنون﴾: «كأن» is a particle of comparison and accusative; «هن» is its noun, «بيض» is its khabar (predicate), and «مكنون» is a naʿt (adjective) of «بيض»; the clause is a second naʿt of «قاصرات».

muyesser-irab:50-50.t: ﴿فأقبل بعضهم على بعض يتساءلون﴾: the fāʾ is a conjunction; «أقبل بعضهم» is a verb and its fāʿil (agent); «على بعض» is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to (mutaʿalliq) «أقبل»; «يتساءلون» is an imperfect verb, nominative (marfūʿ), the wāw being the fāʿil; the clause «يتساءلون» is circumstantial (ḥāliyya), and the clause «أقبل بعضهم» is conjoined to «يطاف عليهم».

muyesser-irab:51-51.t: ﴿قال قائل منهم إني كان لي قرين﴾: «قال قائل» is a verb and its fāʿil (agent); «منهم» is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted naʿt (adjective) of «قائل»; «إني»: «إن» is an abrogating particle (ḥarf nāsikh), and the yāʾ is its noun; «كان» is an incomplete (nāqiṣ), abrogating past verb; «لي» is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to the omitted fronted khabar (predicate) of «كان»; «قرين» is its delayed noun; the clause «كان» is the khabar of «إن», and the clause of «إن», its noun and its khabar is the object of the saying (maqūl al-qawl).

muyesser-irab:52-52.t: ﴿يقول أئنك لمن المصدقين﴾: «يقول» is an imperfect verb, nominative (marfūʿ), its fāʿil (agent) latent (mustatir), its implied form being "he" (هو); the hamza is for the rhetorical question of disapproval (istifhām inkārī); «إن» is an abrogating particle (ḥarf nāsikh), the kāf is its noun, the lām is the shifted lām (al-lām al-muzaḥlaqa), and «من المصدقين» is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to (mutaʿalliq) the omitted khabar (predicate) of «إن»; the clause is the object of the saying (maqūl al-qawl), and the clause «يقول» is a naʿt (adjective) of «قرين».

muyesser-irab:53-53.t:
﴿أئذا متنا وكنا ترابا وعظاما﴾: the hamza is for the rhetorical question of disapproval (istifhām inkārī); «إذا» is an adverb of the future including the meaning of condition; «متنا» is a past verb, «نا» being the fāʿil (agent), and the clause «متنا» is in the position of a genitive (majrūr) because the adverb is annexed to it; «كنا» is an incomplete (nāqiṣ) past verb, «نا» is its noun, «ترابًا» is its khabar (predicate), and «عظامًا» is conjoined to «ترابًا».
﴿أئنا لمدينون﴾: the hamza is interrogative; «إن» is an abrogating particle (ḥarf nāsikh), «نا» is its noun, the lām is the shifted lām (al-lām al-muzaḥlaqa), and «مدينون» is the khabar of «إن».

muyesser-irab:54-54.t: ﴿قال هل أنتم مطلعون﴾: «قال» is an incomplete (nāqiṣ) past verb [Translator's note: so in the source; «قال» is not an incomplete verb], its fāʿil (agent) a latent (mustatir) pronoun, its implied form being "he" (هو); «هل» is an interrogative particle; «أنتم» is a mubtadaʾ (subject); and «مطلعون» is the khabar (predicate).

muyesser-irab:55-55.t: ﴿فاطلع فرآه في سواء الجحيم﴾: the fāʾ is a conjunction; «اطلع» is a past verb, its fāʿil (agent) a latent (mustatir) pronoun, its implied form being "he" (هو); «فرآه»: the fāʾ is a conjunction, «رآه» is a past verb, its fāʿil latent, and the hāʾ is the mafʿūl bihi (direct object), i.e. "he saw his companion" (رأى قرينه); «في سواء الجحيم» is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to (mutaʿalliq) «رآه», or attached to an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial), i.e. "plunged in the middle of Hell" (مرتطمًا في وسط جهنم).

muyesser-irab:56-56.t: ﴿قال تالله إن كدت لتردين﴾: «قال» is a past verb whose fāʿil (agent) is latent (mustatir); «تالله»: the tāʾ is a particle of oath and genitive, the Name of Majesty is genitive (majrūr), and the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted verb, its implied form being "I swear" (أقسم); «إن» is lightened from the heavy [«إنّ»] and left inoperative (muhmala); «كدت» is one of the verbs of approximation (afʿāl al-muqāraba), the tāʾ being its noun; the lām is the distinguishing lām (al-fāriqa); «تردين» is an imperfect verb, nominative (marfūʿ), its fāʿil a latent pronoun, its implied form being "you" (أنت); the nūn is for protection (wiqāya), and the yāʾ, omitted for lightness, is the mafʿūl bihi (direct object); the clause «لتردين» is the khabar (predicate) of «كدت», and the clause «إن كدت» is the answer to the oath, with no grammatical position.

muyesser-irab:57-57.t: ﴿ولولا نعمة ربي لكنت من المحضرين﴾: the wāw is a conjunction; «لولا» is a particle of non-occurrence due to existence (ḥarf imtināʿ li-wujūd); «نعمة» is a mubtadaʾ (subject) and «ربي» is muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct); the khabar (predicate) of the mubtadaʾ is necessarily omitted, the implied form being "existing" (موجودة); «لكنت»: the lām occurs in the apodosis (jawāb) of «لولا»; «كنت» is an incomplete (nāqiṣ), abrogating past verb, and the tāʾ is its noun; «من المحضرين» is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to (mutaʿalliq) the omitted khabar of «كان», i.e. "of those brought to the punishment" (من الذين أحضروا العذاب).

muyesser-irab:58-58.t: ﴿أفما نحن بميتين﴾: the hamza is interrogative, and the fāʾ conjoins to something omitted, its implied form being "are we then immortal and blessed, so that we will not die?" (أنحن مخلدون منعمون فما نحن بميتين؟); «ما» is the Ḥijāzī negative that works like «ليس»; «نحن» is the noun of «ما»; «بميتين»: the bāʾ is a connective (ṣila) preposition, and «ميتين» is the khabar (predicate) of the Ḥijāzī «ما», accusative (manṣūb) in position and genitive (majrūr) in form by the bāʾ.

muyesser-irab:59-59.t: ﴿إلا موتتنا الأولى وما نحن بمعذبين﴾: «إلا» is a particle of restriction (ḥaṣr), the exception being disconnected (munqaṭiʿ), and «موتتنا» is excepted by «إلا», accusative (manṣūb); or the exception is emptied (mufarragh), and «موتتنا» is a mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object), accusative; «الأولى» is a naʿt (adjective); the wāw is a conjunction; «ما» is the Ḥijāzī negative that works like «ليس»; «نحن» is the noun of «ما»; «بمعذبين»: the bāʾ is a connective (ṣila) preposition, and «معذبين» is the khabar (predicate) of the Ḥijāzī «ما», accusative in position and genitive (majrūr) in form by the bāʾ.

muyesser-irab:60-60.t: ﴿إن هذا لهو الفوز العظيم﴾: «إن» is an abrogating particle (ḥarf nāsikh), «هذا» is its noun, the lām is the shifted lām (al-lām al-muzaḥlaqa), «هو» is a mubtadaʾ (subject), «الفوز» is the khabar (predicate) of «هو», and the clause is the khabar of «إن»; or «هو» is a pronoun of separation (ḍamīr faṣl) and «الفوز» is the khabar of «إن»; «العظيم» is a naʿt (adjective) of «الفوز».

muyesser-irab:61-61.t: ﴿لمثل هذا فليعمل العاملون﴾: «لمثل» is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to (mutaʿalliq) «يعمل»; «هذا» is muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct); the fāʾ is the fāʾ al-faṣīḥa (signalling an implied condition); the lām is the lām of command; «يعمل» is an imperfect verb, jussive (majzūm) by the lām of command; and «العاملون» is the fāʿil (agent).

muyesser-irab:62-62.t: ﴿أذلك خير نزلا أم شجرة الزقوم﴾: the clause is the object of an omitted verb of saying; the hamza is for a question of disapproval and rebuke (istifhām inkārī tawbīkhī); «ذلك» is a mubtadaʾ (subject), «خير» is the khabar (predicate), and «نزلًا» is a tamyīz (specification) of «خير» — and it has been said: a ḥāl (circumstantial); «أم» is a conjunction, and «شجرة الزقوم» is conjoined to «ذلك».

muyesser-irab:63-63.t: ﴿إنا جعلناها فتنة للظالمين﴾: «إن» is an abrogating particle (ḥarf nāsikh), «نا» is its noun, and the clause «جعلنا» is the khabar (predicate); «جعلناها» is a past verb, «نا» is the fāʿil (agent), the hāʾ is the first mafʿūl bihi (direct object), and «فتنة» is the second mafʿūl bihi; «للظالمين» is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted naʿt (adjective) of «فتنة».

muyesser-irab:64-64.t: ﴿إنها شجرة تخرج في أصل الجحيم﴾: «إن» is an abrogating particle (ḥarf nāsikh), the hāʾ is its noun, and «شجرة» is its khabar (predicate); the clause «تخرج» is a naʿt (adjective) of «شجرة»; «في أصل الجحيم» is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to (mutaʿalliq) «تخرج».

muyesser-irab:65-65.t: ﴿طلعها كأنه رؤوس الشياطين﴾: «طلعها» is a mubtadaʾ (subject); «كأن» is a particle of comparison and accusative, the hāʾ is its noun, and «رؤوس» is its khabar (predicate); the clause of «كأن» is the khabar of the mubtadaʾ; and «الشياطين» is muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct).

muyesser-irab:66-66.t: ﴿فإنهم لآكلون منها فمالئون منها البطون﴾: the fāʾ is conjunctive; «إن» is an abrogating particle (ḥarf nāsikh), «هم» is its noun, the lām is the shifted lām (al-lām al-muzaḥlaqa), and «آكلون» is the khabar (predicate) of «إن»; «منها» is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to (mutaʿalliq) «آكلون»; «فمالئون»: the fāʾ is a conjunction of sequence with immediacy, and «مالئون» is conjoined to «آكلون»; «منها» is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to «مالئون»; and «البطون» is the object of «مالئون».

muyesser-irab:67-67.t: ﴿ثم إن لهم عليها لشوبا من حميم﴾: «ثم» is a conjunction of sequence with delay; «إن» is an abrogating particle (ḥarf nāsikh); «لهم» is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to (mutaʿalliq) its omitted fronted khabar (predicate); «عليها» is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial); the lām is the shifted lām (al-lām al-muzaḥlaqa); «شوبًا» is its delayed noun; and «من حميم» is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to an omitted naʿt (adjective) of «شوبًا».

muyesser-irab:68-68.t: ﴿ثم إن مرجعهم لإلى الجحيم﴾: «ثم» is a conjunction of sequence with delay; «إن» is an abrogating particle (ḥarf nāsikh); «مرجعهم» is its noun; the lām is the shifted lām (al-lām al-muzaḥlaqa); and «إلى الجحيم» is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to (mutaʿalliq) the omitted khabar (predicate) of «إن».

muyesser-irab:69-69.t: ﴿إنهم ألفوا آباءهم ضالين﴾: the clause gives the reason (taʿlīl) for what preceded of their being afflicted with various kinds of punishment; «إن» is an abrogating particle (ḥarf nāsikh) and «هم» is its noun; «ألفوا» is a past verb, the wāw being the fāʿil (agent); «آباءهم» is the first object and «ضالين» the second object; and the clause «ألفوا» [is the khabar of] «إن» [Translator's note: the word «خبر» (khabar) is missing from the source, which reads only «وجملة ألفوا إن»].

muyesser-irab:70-70.t: ﴿فهم على آثارهم يهرعون﴾: the fāʾ is causal (taʿlīliyya); «هم» is a mubtadaʾ (subject); «على آثارهم» is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to (mutaʿalliq) «يهرعون»; and the clause «يهرعون» is the khabar (predicate) of the mubtadaʾ «هم».

muyesser-irab:71-71.t: ﴿ولقد ضل قبلهم أكثر الأولين﴾: the lām is in answer to the omitted oath; «قد» is a particle of verification (taḥqīq); «ضل» is a past verb, indeclinable (mabnī) on fatḥa; «قبلهم» is an adverb attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial); and «أكثر الأولين» is the fāʿil (agent).

muyesser-irab:72-72.t: ﴿ولقد أرسلنا فيهم منذرين﴾: the wāw is a conjunction; the lām is in answer to the omitted oath; «قد» is a particle of verification (taḥqīq); «أرسلنا» is a past verb, «نا» being the fāʿil (agent); «فيهم» is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to (mutaʿalliq) «أرسلنا»; and «منذرين» is the mafʿūl bihi (direct object).

muyesser-irab:73-73.t: ﴿فانظر كيف كان عاقبة المنذرين﴾: the fāʾ is the fāʾ al-faṣīḥa (signalling an implied condition); «انظر» is an imperative verb, its fāʿil (agent) latent (mustatir), its implied form being "you" (أنت); «كيف» is an interrogative noun in the position of an accusative (manṣūb), the fronted khabar (predicate) of «كان»; «كان» is an incomplete (nāqiṣ), abrogating past verb; «عاقبة» is its delayed noun; and «المنذرين» is a mafʿūl bihi (direct object) [Translator's note: so in the source; «المنذرين» here is muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct) to «عاقبة»].

muyesser-irab:74-74.t: ﴿إلا عباد الله المخلصين﴾: «إلا» is a particle of exception meaning "but" (لكن); «عباد الله» is the excepted, accusative (manṣūb); and «المخلصين» is a naʿt (adjective) of «عباد».

muyesser-irab:75-75.t:
﴿ولقد نادانا نوح﴾: speech that is resumptive, with no grammatical position; the lām is in answer to the omitted oath; «قد» is a particle of verification (taḥqīq); «نادانا نوح»: a past verb, «نا» being a fronted mafʿūl bihi (direct object), and «نوح» a delayed fāʿil (agent).
﴿فلنعم المجيبون﴾: the fāʾ is a conjunction, and the lām is in answer to an omitted oath; the answer of each of the two oaths is omitted, because the context indicates it; «نعم» is an inflexible (jāmid) past verb for expressing praise; «المجيبون» is the fāʿil of «نعم»; and the one specified for praise (al-makhṣūṣ bi-l-madḥ) is omitted, its implied form being "We" (نحن).

muyesser-irab:76-76.t: ﴿ونجيناه وأهله من الكرب العظيم﴾: the wāw is a conjunction; «نجيناه» is a past verb, «نا» is the fāʿil (agent), and the hāʾ is the mafʿūl bihi (direct object); «أهله» is conjoined to the hāʾ, or a mafʿūl maʿahu (object of accompaniment); «من الكرب» is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to (mutaʿalliq) «نجيناه»; and «العظيم» is a naʿt (adjective) of «الكرب».

muyesser-irab:77-77.t: ﴿وجعلنا ذريته هم الباقين﴾: the wāw is a conjunction; «جعلنا» is conjoined to «نجيناه»; «ذريته» is the mafʿūl bihi (direct object); «هم» is a pronoun of separation (ḍamīr faṣl) with no grammatical position; and «الباقين» is the second object of «جعلنا».

muyesser-irab:78-78.t: ﴿وتركنا عليه في الآخرين﴾: the wāw is a conjunction; «تركنا» is a past verb, «نا» being the fāʿil (agent); «عليه» is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted naʿt (adjective) of the omitted object, i.e. "praise being upon him" (ثناء كائنًا عليه); and «في الآخرين» is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to an omitted second mafʿūl bihi (direct object) of «تركنا».

muyesser-irab:79-79.t: ﴿سلام على نوح في العالمين﴾: «سلام» is a mubtadaʾ (subject). «على نوح» is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted khabar (predicate). «في العالمين» is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to the omitted khabar. The clause «سلام على نوح في العالمين» is explicative (tafsīriyya) of «تركنا», with no grammatical position.

muyesser-irab:80-80.t: ﴿إنا كذلك نجزي المحسنين﴾: «إنّا»: «إن» is an abrogating particle (ḥarf nāsikh) and «نا» is its noun; «كذلك»: the kāf is a noun meaning "like" (مثل), indeclinable (mabnī) on fatḥa, in the position of an accusative (manṣūb) as a naʿt (adjective) of an omitted maṣdar (verbal noun) placed before its governor, i.e. "with a recompense like that We recompense the doers of good" (جزاءً مثلَ ذلك نجزي المحسنين); «ذلك»: «ذا» is a demonstrative in the position of a genitive (majrūr) as muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct), the lām is for distance, and the kāf is a particle of address; «نجزي» is an imperfect verb, its fāʿil (agent) latent (mustatir), its implied form being "we" (نحن); «المحسنين» is the mafʿūl bihi (direct object); and the clause «نجزي» is the khabar (predicate) of «إن».

muyesser-irab:81-81.t: ﴿إنه من عبادنا المؤمنين﴾: «إن» is an abrogating particle (ḥarf nāsikh), the hāʾ is its noun, «من عبادنا» is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to (mutaʿalliq) its omitted khabar (predicate), and «المؤمنين» is a naʿt (adjective) of «عبادنا».

muyesser-irab:82-82.t: ﴿ثم أغرقنا الآخرين﴾: «ثم» is a conjunction of delay; «أغرقنا» is a past verb, «نا» being the fāʿil (agent); and «الآخرين» is the mafʿūl bihi (direct object).

muyesser-irab:83-83.t: ﴿وإن من شيعته لإبراهيم﴾: the wāw is a conjunction, or resumptive; «إن» is an abrogating particle (ḥarf nāsikh); «من شيعته» is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to (mutaʿalliq) its omitted fronted khabar (predicate); the lām is the shifted lām (al-lām al-muzaḥlaqa); «إبراهيم» is its delayed noun; and the clause «وإن من شيعته...» is conjoined, or resumptive, with no grammatical position.

muyesser-irab:84-84.t: ﴿إذ جاء ربه بقلب سليم﴾: «إذ» is a noun indeclinable (mabnī) on sukūn, in the position of an accusative (manṣūb) as the mafʿūl bihi (direct object) of an omitted verb, its implied form being "remember" (اذكر); the clause «جاء» is in the position of a genitive (majrūr) by annexation; «جاء» is a past verb, its fāʿil (agent) latent (mustatir), its implied form being "he" (هو), referring to Ibrāhīm; «ربه» is the mafʿūl bihi; «بقلب» is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to (mutaʿalliq) «جاء»; and «سليم» is a naʿt (adjective).

muyesser-irab:85-85.t:
﴿إذ قال لأبيه وقومه﴾: «إذ» is a noun indeclinable (mabnī) on sukūn, in the position of an accusative (manṣūb) as a badal (substitute) from «إذ» in the preceding ayah, or an adverb attached to (mutaʿalliq) «سليم» or to «جاء»; the clause «قال» is in the position of a genitive (majrūr) by annexation; «قال» is a past verb, its fāʿil (agent) a latent (mustatir) pronoun, its implied form being "he" (هو); and «لأبيه» is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to «قال».
﴿ماذا تعبدون﴾: «ما» is a mubtadaʾ (subject), «ذا» is a relative noun, the khabar (predicate), and the clause «تعبدون» is the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun, with no grammatical position. Or «ماذا» is an interrogative noun in the position of an accusative, a fronted object of «تعبدون»; «تعبدون» is an imperfect verb, nominative (marfūʿ), the wāw being the fāʿil; and the clause «ماذا تعبدون» is the object of the saying (maqūl al-qawl).

muyesser-irab:86-86.t: ﴿أئفكا آلهة دون الله تريدون﴾: the hamza is for a question of disapproval and rebuke (istifhām inkārī tawbīkhī); «إفكًا» is a mafʿūl li-ajlihi (object of purpose), i.e. "do you want gods other than Allah out of falsehood?" (أتريدون آلهة دون الله إفكًا); «آلهة» is the mafʿūl bihi (direct object); and «دون الله» is an adverb attached to (mutaʿalliq) «تريدون». Or «إفكا» is the mafʿūl bihi of «تريدون», and «آلهة» is a badal (substitute) from it. Or «إفكا» is a ḥāl (circumstantial) from the fāʿil (agent) of «تريدون», i.e. "do you want gods while lying" (أتريدون آلهة آفكين), or "being people of falsehood" (ذوي إفك). «تريدون» is an imperfect verb, nominative (marfūʿ), the wāw being the fāʿil.

muyesser-irab:87-87.t: ﴿فما ظنكم برب العالمين﴾: the fāʾ is a conjunction; «ما» is an interrogative noun for disapproval and rebuke, in the position of a nominative (marfūʿ), a mubtadaʾ (subject); «ظنكم» is its khabar (predicate); and «برب العالمين» is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to (mutaʿalliq) «ظنكم».

muyesser-irab:88-88.t: ﴿فنظر نظرة في النجوم﴾: the fāʾ is a conjunction; «نظر» is a past verb, its fāʿil (agent) latent (mustatir), its implied form being "he" (هو); «نظرة» stands in place of the mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object), accusative (manṣūb); «في النجوم» is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to (mutaʿalliq) «نظر». It has been said: the speech involves the omission of a muḍāf, i.e. "in the science of the stars" (في علم النجوم).

muyesser-irab:89-89.t: ﴿فقال إني سقيم﴾: the fāʾ is a conjunction; «قال» is a past verb whose fāʿil (agent) is latent (mustatir); «إن» is an abrogating particle (ḥarf nāsikh), the yāʾ is its noun, and «سقيم» is its khabar (predicate); «إن» and what falls within its scope is in the position of an accusative (manṣūb) as the object of the saying (maqūl al-qawl).

muyesser-irab:90-90.t: ﴿فتولوا عنه مدبرين﴾: the fāʾ is a conjunction; «تولوا» is a past verb, the wāw being the fāʿil (agent); «عنه» is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to (mutaʿalliq) «تولوا»; and «مدبرين» is a ḥāl (circumstantial) from the wāw in «تولوا».

muyesser-irab:91-91.t: ﴿فراغ إلى آلهتهم فقال ألا تأكلون﴾: the fāʾ is a conjunction; «راغ» is a past verb whose fāʿil (agent) is latent (mustatir); «إلى آلهتهم» is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to (mutaʿalliq) «راغ»; «فقال» is conjoined to «راغ»; the hamza is interrogative, «لا» is negating, and «تأكلون» is an imperfect verb, nominative (marfūʿ), the wāw being the fāʿil; the interrogative clause is the object of the saying (maqūl al-qawl).

muyesser-irab:92-92.t: ﴿ما لكم لا تنطقون﴾: «ما» is an interrogative noun, a mubtadaʾ (subject); «لكم» is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted khabar (predicate); «لا» is negating; «تنطقون» is an imperfect verb, nominative (marfūʿ), the wāw being the fāʿil (agent); the clause «لا تنطقون» is in the position of an accusative (manṣūb) as a ḥāl (circumstantial); and the clause «ما لكم» is the object of an omitted verb of saying, the implied form being "they did not speak, so he said: what is the matter with you that you do not speak?" (فلم ينطقوا فقال: ما لكم لا تنطقون).

muyesser-irab:93-93.t: ﴿فراغ عليهم ضربا باليمين﴾: the fāʾ conjoins to something omitted, its implied form being "they did not answer, so he turned" (فلم يجيبوا فراغ); «عليهم» is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to (mutaʿalliq) «راغ»; «ضربًا» is a maṣdar (verbal noun) occurring in the place of a ḥāl (circumstantial), i.e. "he turned upon them, striking" (فراغ عليهم ضاربًا), or a mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object) of an implied verb, i.e. "striking a striking" (يضرب ضربًا), the clause «يضرب ضربًا» being in the position of an accusative (manṣūb) as a ḥāl; and «باليمين» is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to «ضربًا» or to its governor.

muyesser-irab:94-94.t: ﴿فأقبلوا إليه يزفون﴾: the fāʾ is a conjunction; «أقبلوا» is a past verb, the wāw being the fāʿil (agent); «إليه» is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to (mutaʿalliq) «أقبلوا» or to «يزفون»; and the clause «يزفون» is in the position of an accusative (manṣūb) as a ḥāl (circumstantial) from the fāʿil of «أقبلوا».

muyesser-irab:95-95.t: ﴿قال أتعبدون ما تنحتون﴾: «قال» is a past verb, its fāʿil (agent) latent (mustatir), its implied form being "he" (هو); the hamza is for a question of disapproval and rebuke (istifhām inkārī tawbīkhī); «تعبدون» is an imperfect verb, nominative (marfūʿ), the wāw being the fāʿil; «ما» is the mafʿūl bihi (direct object), and the clause «تنحتون» is the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun, with no grammatical position, the returning pronoun (ʿāʾid) being omitted; or «ما» is maṣdariyya, i.e. "your carving" (نحتكم); or an indefinite noun qualified by an adjective (nakira mawṣūfa), i.e. "what you have carved" (منحوتكم); and it has been said: it is interrogative, for rebuke, i.e. "and what is it that you do?" (وأي شيء تعملون؟) [Translator's note: this gloss uses «تعملون» from the next ayah (96) rather than «تنحتون»; it appears to have been carried over from the entry on ayah 96].

muyesser-irab:96-96.t:
﴿والله خلقكم﴾: the wāw is circumstantial (ḥāliyya) or resumptive; «الله» is a mubtadaʾ (subject), and the clause «خلقكم» is the khabar (predicate): it is a past verb whose fāʿil (agent) is latent (mustatir), and the kāf is the mafʿūl bihi (direct object). The clause «والله خلقكم» is in the position of an accusative (manṣūb) as a ḥāl (circumstantial), or resumptive, with no grammatical position.
﴿وما تعملون﴾: the wāw is a conjunction; «ما» is a relative or maṣdariyya; and it has been said: it is interrogative, for rebuke, i.e. "and what is it that you do?" (وأي شيء تعملون؟); and it has been said: it is negating, i.e. "the doing is in reality not yours, so you do not do anything"; «تعملون» is an imperfect verb, nominative (marfūʿ), the wāw being the fāʿil.

muyesser-irab:97-97.t: ﴿قالوا ابنوا له بنيانا فألقوه في الجحيم﴾: «قالوا» is a past verb, the wāw being the fāʿil (agent); «ابنوا» is an imperative verb, the wāw being the fāʿil, and the clause is the object of the saying (maqūl al-qawl); «له» is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to (mutaʿalliq) «ابنوا»; «بنيانًا» is the mafʿūl bihi (direct object); «فألقوه» is conjoined to «ابنوا»: it is an imperative verb, the wāw is the fāʿil, and the hāʾ is the mafʿūl bihi; and «في الجحيم» is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to «ألقوه».

muyesser-irab:98-98.t: ﴿فأرادوا به كيدا فجعلناهم الأسفلين﴾: the fāʾ is a conjunction; «أرادوا» is a past verb, the wāw being the fāʿil (agent); «به» is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to (mutaʿalliq) «أرادوا»; «كيدًا» is the mafʿūl bihi (direct object); «فجعلناهم» is conjoined to «فأرادوا»: it is a past verb, «نا» is the fāʿil, «هم» is the first mafʿūl bihi, and «الأسفلين» is the second mafʿūl bihi.

muyesser-irab:99-99.t: ﴿وقال إني ذاهب إلى ربي سيهدين﴾: the wāw conjoins to something omitted, its implied form being "so he came out of the fire safe, and said…" (فخرج من النار سالمًا، وقال...); «إن» is an abrogating particle (ḥarf nāsikh), the yāʾ is its noun, and «ذاهب» is its khabar (predicate); «إلى ربي» is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to (mutaʿalliq) «ذاهب»; the sīn is a particle of the future; «يهدين» is an imperfect verb, nominative (marfūʿ) with an implied ḍamma on the yāʾ; the nūn is for protection (wiqāya); and the yāʾ of the pronoun, omitted in observance of the verse-endings (fawāṣil), is the mafʿūl bihi (direct object), i.e. «سيهديني».

muyesser-irab:100-100.t: ﴿رب هب لي من الصالحين﴾: «رب» is the one addressed (munādā), annexed to the omitted yāʾ of the first person; «هب» is a verb of supplication, indeclinable (mabnī) on sukūn, its fāʿil (agent) a latent (mustatir) pronoun, its implied form being "you" (أنت); «لي» is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to (mutaʿalliq) «هب»; and «من الصالحين» is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to an omitted naʿt (adjective) of an omitted mafʿūl bihi (direct object), i.e. "a child from among the righteous" (ولدًا من الصالحين).

muyesser-irab:101-101.t: ﴿فبشرناه بغلام حليم﴾: the fāʾ conjoins to something omitted, its implied form being "so We answered him" (فاستجبنا له); «بشرناه» is a past verb, «نا» is the fāʿil (agent), and the hāʾ is the mafʿūl bihi (direct object); «بغلام» is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to (mutaʿalliq) «بشرناه»; and «حليم» is a naʿt (adjective).

muyesser-irab:102-102.t:
﴿فلما بلغ معه السعي﴾: the fāʾ is resumptive; «لما» is temporal (ḥīniyya) or linking (rābiṭa); «بلغ» is a past verb, its fāʿil (agent) latent (mustatir), its implied form being "he" (هو); «معه» is an adverb attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial); and «السعي» is the mafʿūl bihi (direct object).
﴿قال يا بني إني أرى في المنام﴾: «قال» is a past verb whose fāʿil is latent, and the clause «قال» has no grammatical position, because it is the apodosis (jawāb) of «لما»; «يا» is a vocative particle; «بني» is the one addressed (munādā), annexed to the yāʾ of the first person; «إن» is an abrogating particle (ḥarf nāsikh) and the yāʾ is its noun; «أرى» is an imperfect verb whose fāʿil is latent, and the clause «أرى» is the khabar (predicate) of «إن»; «في المنام» is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to «أرى».
﴿أني أذبحك فانظر ماذا ترى﴾: «أن» is an abrogating particle and the yāʾ is its noun; «أذبحك» is an imperfect verb whose fāʿil is latent, the kāf being the mafʿūl bihi, and the clause «أذبحك» is the khabar of «أن»; «أني أذبحك» stands in place of the object(s) of «أرى»; «فانظر»: the fāʾ is the fāʾ al-faṣīḥa (signalling an implied condition), and «انظر» is an imperative verb, indeclinable (mabnī) on sukūn, its fāʿil necessarily latent, its implied form being "you" (أنت); «ماذا» is interrogative, accusative (manṣūb) by «ترى»; or «ما» is interrogative, a mubtadaʾ (subject), and «ذا» is a relative, the khabar; or «ماذا» means "that which" (الذي), and so it is governed by «انظر»; «ترى» is an imperfect verb, nominative (marfūʿ). The clause «فلما بلغ معه...» is resumptive, with no grammatical position.
﴿قال يا أبت افعل ما تؤمر ستجدني إن شاء الله من الصابرين﴾: «يا» is a vocative particle; «أبت» is the one addressed, annexed to the yāʾ of the first person, which is compensated for by the tāʾ, and the tāʾ is in the position of a genitive (majrūr), because what it compensates for is so; «افعل» is an imperative verb, its fāʿil latent, its implied form being "you" (أنت); «ما» is a relative noun, the object of «افعل», and the clause «تؤمر» is the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun, with no grammatical position, the returning pronoun (ʿāʾid) being omitted, its implied form being "what you are commanded with" (ما تؤمر به); or «ما» is maṣdariyya, i.e. "your command" (أمرك), the maṣdar being annexed to its object; the sīn is a particle of the future; «تجدني» is an imperfect verb, nominative, the nūn is for protection (wiqāya), the fāʿil is a latent pronoun, its implied form being "you" (أنت), and the yāʾ is the mafʿūl bihi; and «من الصابرين» is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to an omitted second object.

muyesser-irab:103-103.t: ﴿فلما أسلما وتله للجبين﴾: the fāʾ is a conjunction; «لما» is temporal (ḥīniyya) or linking (rābiṭa); «أسلما» is a past verb, the alif being the fāʿil (agent); «وتله»: the wāw is a conjunction, and «تله» is a past verb, its fāʿil latent (mustatir), its implied form being "he" (هو), i.e. Ibrāhīm, and the hāʾ is the mafʿūl bihi (direct object); «للجبين» is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial); the apodosis (jawāb) of «لما» is omitted, its implied form being "their patience became manifest" (ظهر صبرهما) or "We gave them their reward abundantly" (أجزلنا لهما أجرهما).

muyesser-irab:104-104.t: ﴿وناديناه أن يا إبراهيم﴾: the wāw is a conjunction; «ناديناه» is a past verb, «نا» is the fāʿil (agent), and the hāʾ is the mafʿūl bihi (direct object); «أن» is explicative (tafsīriyya), because calling contains the meaning of saying without its letters, and the clause after it is explicative, with no grammatical position. «يا» is a vocative particle, and «إبراهيم» is the one addressed (munādā), a singular proper name, indeclinable (mabnī) on ḍamma.

muyesser-irab:105-105.t:
﴿قد صدقت الرؤيا﴾: «قد» is a particle of verification (taḥqīq), «صدقت» is a past verb, the tāʾ is the fāʿil (agent), and «الرؤيا» is the mafʿūl bihi (direct object).
﴿إنا كذلك نجزي المحسنين﴾: «إنّا»: «إن» is an abrogating particle (ḥarf nāsikh) and «نا» is its noun; «كذلك»: the kāf is a noun meaning "like" (مثل), indeclinable (mabnī) on fatḥa, in the position of an accusative (manṣūb) as a naʿt (adjective) of an omitted maṣdar (verbal noun) placed before its governor, i.e. "with a recompense like that We recompense the doers of good" (جزاءً مثلَ ذلك نجزي المحسنين); «ذلك»: «ذا» is a demonstrative in the position of a genitive (majrūr) as muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct), the lām is for distance, and the kāf is a particle of address; «نجزي» is an imperfect verb, its fāʿil latent (mustatir), its implied form being "we" (نحن); «المحسنين» is the mafʿūl bihi; and the clause «نجزي المحسنين» is the khabar (predicate) of «إن».

muyesser-irab:106-106.t: ﴿إن هذا لهو البلاء المبين﴾: «إن» is an abrogating particle (ḥarf nāsikh), «هذا» is its noun, the lām is the shifted lām (al-lām al-muzaḥlaqa), «هو» is a mubtadaʾ (subject), «البلاء» is the khabar (predicate) of «هو», and the clause «لهو البلاء المبين» is the khabar of «إن»; or «هو» is a pronoun of separation (ḍamīr faṣl) and «البلاء» is the khabar of «إن»; «المبين» is a naʿt (adjective) of «البلاء».

muyesser-irab:107-107.t: ﴿وفديناه بذبح عظيم﴾: the wāw is a conjunction; «فديناه» is a past verb, «نا» is the fāʿil (agent), and the hāʾ is the mafʿūl bihi (direct object); the clause is conjoined to «ناديناه»; «بذبح» is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to (mutaʿalliq) «فديناه»; and «عظيم» is a naʿt (adjective) of «ذبح».

muyesser-irab:108-108.t: ﴿وتركنا عليه في الآخرين﴾: the wāw is a conjunction; «تركنا» is a past verb, «نا» being the fāʿil (agent); «عليه» is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted naʿt (adjective) of the omitted object, i.e. "praise being upon him" (ثناء كائنًا عليه); and «في الآخرين» is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to an omitted second mafʿūl bihi (direct object) of «تركنا».

muyesser-irab:109-109.t: ﴿سلام على إبراهيم﴾: «سلام» is a mubtadaʾ (subject); «على إبراهيم» is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted khabar (predicate); and the clause «سلام على إبراهيم» is the object of an omitted verb of saying, i.e. "this is said to him among the later generations" (يقال له هذا في الآخرين).

muyesser-irab:110-110.t: ﴿كذلك نجزي المحسنين﴾: «كذلك»: the kāf is a noun meaning "like" (مثل), indeclinable (mabnī) on fatḥa, in the position of an accusative (manṣūb) as a naʿt (adjective) of an omitted maṣdar (verbal noun) placed before its governor, i.e. "with a recompense like that We recompense the doers of good" (جزاءً مثلَ ذلك نجزي المحسنين); «ذلك»: «ذا» is a demonstrative in the position of a genitive (majrūr) as muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct), the lām is for distance, and the kāf is a particle of address; «نجزي» is an imperfect verb, its fāʿil (agent) latent (mustatir), its implied form being "we" (نحن); and «المحسنين» is the mafʿūl bihi (direct object).

muyesser-irab:111-111.t: ﴿إنه من عبادنا المؤمنين﴾: «إن» is an abrogating particle (ḥarf nāsikh), the hāʾ is its noun, «من عبادنا» is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted khabar (predicate), and «المؤمنين» is a naʿt (adjective); the clause gives the reason (taʿlīliyya), with no grammatical position.

muyesser-irab:112-112.t: ﴿وبشرناه بإسحاق نبيا من الصالحين﴾: the wāw is a conjunction; «بشرناه» is a past verb, «نا» is the fāʿil (agent), and the hāʾ is the mafʿūl bihi (direct object); «بإسحاق» is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to (mutaʿalliq) «بشرناه»; «نبيا» is a ḥāl (circumstantial) from «إسحاق»; and «من الصالحين» is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to an omitted naʿt (adjective) of «نبيا», or a second ḥāl.

muyesser-irab:113-113.t:
﴿وباركنا عليه وعلى إسحاق﴾: the wāw is a conjunction; «باركنا» is conjoined to what came before: it is a past verb, «نا» being the fāʿil (agent); «عليه» is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to (mutaʿalliq) «باركنا»; and «على إسحاق» is conjoined to «عليه».
﴿ومن ذريتهما محسن وظالم لنفسه مبين﴾: «من ذريتهما» is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to an omitted fronted khabar (predicate); «محسن» is a delayed mubtadaʾ (subject); «ظالم» is conjoined to «محسن»; «لنفسه» is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to «ظالم»; and «مبين» is a naʿt (adjective) of «ظالم».

muyesser-irab:114-114.t: ﴿ولقد مننا على موسى وهارون﴾: speech that is resumptive, with no grammatical position; or the wāw conjoins to what preceded; the lām is in answer to the omitted oath; «قد» is a particle of verification (taḥqīq); «مننا» is a past verb, «نا» being the fāʿil (agent); and «على موسى وهارون» is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to (mutaʿalliq) «مننا».

muyesser-irab:115-115.t: ﴿ونجيناهما وقومهما من الكرب العظيم﴾: the wāw is a conjunction; «نجيناهما» is conjoined to «مننا»: it is a past verb, «نا» is the fāʿil (agent), and «هما» is the mafʿūl bihi (direct object); «قومهما» is a mafʿūl maʿahu (object of accompaniment), or conjoined to the pronoun in «نجيناهما»; «من الكرب» is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to (mutaʿalliq) «نجيناهما»; and «العظيم» is a naʿt (adjective) of «الكرب».

muyesser-irab:116-116.t: ﴿ونصرناهم فكانوا هم الغالبين﴾: conjoined to what came before; «نصرناهم» is a past verb, «نا» is the fāʿil (agent), and «هم» is the mafʿūl bihi (direct object); «فكانوا»: the fāʾ is a conjunction, «كان» is an incomplete (nāqiṣ) past verb, and the wāw is its noun; «هم» is a pronoun of separation (ḍamīr faṣl) with no grammatical position — and it has been said: a tawkīd (emphasis) of the wāw, or a badal (substitute) from it; and «الغالبين» is the khabar (predicate) of «كانوا».

muyesser-irab:117-117.t: ﴿وآتيناهما الكتاب المستبين﴾: conjoined to what came before; «آتيناهما» is a past verb, «نا» is the fāʿil (agent), «هما» is the first mafʿūl bihi (direct object), «الكتاب» is the second mafʿūl bihi, and «المستبين» is a naʿt (adjective) of «الكتاب».

muyesser-irab:118-118.t: ﴿وهديناهما الصراط المستقيم﴾: conjoined to what came before; «وهديناهما» is a past verb, «نا» is the fāʿil (agent), «هما» is the first mafʿūl bihi (direct object), «الصراط» is the second mafʿūl bihi, or accusative (manṣūb) by removal of the preposition, and «المستقيم» is a naʿt (adjective) of «الصراط».

muyesser-irab:119-119.t: ﴿وتركنا عليهما في الآخرين﴾: the wāw is a conjunction; «تركنا» is a past verb, «نا» being the fāʿil (agent); «عليهما» is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted naʿt (adjective) of the omitted object, i.e. "praise being upon them both" (ثناء كائنًا عليهما); and «في الآخرين» is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to an omitted second mafʿūl bihi (direct object) of «تركنا».

muyesser-irab:120-120.t: ﴿سلام على موسى وهارون﴾: «سلام» is a mubtadaʾ (subject), and «على موسى وهارون» is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted khabar (predicate).

muyesser-irab:121-121.t: ﴿إنا كذلك نجزي المحسنين﴾: «إنّا»: «إن» is an abrogating particle (ḥarf nāsikh) and «نا» is its noun; «كذلك»: the kāf is a noun meaning "like" (مثل), indeclinable (mabnī) on fatḥa, in the position of an accusative (manṣūb) as a naʿt (adjective) of an omitted maṣdar (verbal noun) placed before its governor, i.e. "with a recompense like that We recompense the doers of good" (جزاءً مثلَ ذلك نجزي المحسنين); «ذلك»: «ذا» is a demonstrative in the position of a genitive (majrūr) as muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct), the lām is for distance, and the kāf is a particle of address; «نجزي» is an imperfect verb, its fāʿil (agent) latent (mustatir), its implied form being "we" (نحن); «المحسنين» is the mafʿūl bihi (direct object); and the clause «نجزي المحسنين» is the khabar (predicate) of «إن».

muyesser-irab:122-122.t: ﴿إنهما من عبادنا المؤمنين﴾: «إن» is an abrogating particle (ḥarf nāsikh), «هما» is its noun, «من عبادنا» is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to (mutaʿalliq) the omitted khabar (predicate) of «إن», and «المؤمنين» is a naʿt (adjective).

muyesser-irab:123-123.t: ﴿وإن إلياس لمن المرسلين﴾: the wāw is a conjunction or resumptive; «إن» is an abrogating particle (ḥarf nāsikh), «إلياس» is its noun, the lām is the shifted lām (al-lām al-muzaḥlaqa), and «من المرسلين» is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to (mutaʿalliq) the omitted khabar (predicate) of «إن»; the clause «وإن إلياس...» is conjoined, or resumptive, with no grammatical position.

muyesser-irab:124-124.t: ﴿إذ قال لقومه ألا تتقون﴾: «إذ» is a noun indeclinable (mabnī) on sukūn, in the position of an accusative (manṣūb) as the mafʿūl bihi (direct object) of an omitted verb, its implied form being "remember" (اذكر) — and it has been said: an adverb attached to (mutaʿalliq) «المرسلين»; «قال» is a past verb whose fāʿil (agent) is latent (mustatir), and the clause «قال» is in the position of a genitive (majrūr) by annexation; «لقومه» is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to «قال»; the hamza is interrogative, «لا» is negating, «تتقون» is an imperfect verb, nominative (marfūʿ), the wāw being the fāʿil, and the clause is the object of the saying (maqūl al-qawl).

muyesser-irab:125-125.t:
﴿أتدعون بعلا﴾: the hamza is for the rhetorical question of disapproval (istifhām inkārī); «تدعون» is an imperfect verb, nominative (marfūʿ) by the retention of the nūn, the wāw being the fāʿil (agent); and «بعلًا» is the mafʿūl bihi (direct object).
﴿وتذرون أحسن الخالقين﴾: the wāw is a conjunction, and the clause is conjoined to «تدعون»; or the wāw is circumstantial (ḥāliyya), and the clause is in the position of an accusative (manṣūb) as a ḥāl (circumstantial); «تذرون» is an imperfect verb, nominative, the wāw being the fāʿil; and «أحسن الخالقين» is the mafʿūl bihi.

muyesser-irab:126-126.t: ﴿الله ربكم ورب آبائكم الأولين﴾: the Name of Majesty is a badal (substitute) from «أحسن الخالقين», accusative (manṣūb); «ربكم» is a badal from «الله»; and «ورب آبائكم الأولين» is conjoined.

muyesser-irab:127-127.t:
﴿فكذبوه﴾: the fāʾ is a conjunction; «كذبوه» is a past verb, the wāw is the fāʿil (agent), and the hāʾ is the mafʿūl bihi (direct object).
﴿فإنهم لمحضرون﴾: the fāʾ is the fāʾ al-faṣīḥa (signalling an implied condition); «إن» is an abrogating particle (ḥarf nāsikh), «هم» is its noun, the lām is the shifted lām (al-lām al-muzaḥlaqa), and «محضرون» is the khabar (predicate) of «إن».

muyesser-irab:128-128.t: ﴿إلا عباد الله المخلصين﴾: «إلا» is a particle of exception; «عباد الله» is a connected exception (istithnāʾ muttaṣil) from the fāʿil (agent) of «فكذبوه»; and «المخلصين» is a naʿt (adjective) of «عباد الله».

muyesser-irab:129-129.t: ﴿وتركنا عليه في الآخرين﴾: the wāw is a conjunction; «تركنا» is a past verb, «نا» being the fāʿil (agent); «عليه» is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted naʿt (adjective) of the omitted object, i.e. "praise being upon him" (ثناء كائنًا عليه); and «في الآخرين» is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to an omitted second mafʿūl bihi (direct object) of «تركنا».

muyesser-irab:130-130.t: ﴿سلام على إل ياسين﴾: «سلام» is a mubtadaʾ (subject); «على إل ياسين» is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted khabar (predicate); and the clause «سلام على إل ياسين» is the object of an omitted verb of saying, i.e. "this is said to him among the later generations" (يقال له هذا في الآخرين).

zajjaj:174-174.t: ﴿فَتَوَلَّ عَنْهم حَتّى حِينٍ﴾: that is, until the term for which they were granted respite comes to an end.

zajjaj:177-177.t:
﴿فَإذا نَـزَلَ بِساحَتِهِمْ﴾: that is, when the punishment descends upon them; and the punishment of these people in this world was being killed.
And His saying: ﴿فَساءَ صَباحُ المُنْذَرِينَ﴾, that is: "how evil is the morning (فَبِئْسَ صَباحُ)".

zajjaj:180-180.t: ﴿سُبْحانَ رَبِّكَ رَبِّ العِزَّةِ﴾: there are three ways (wujūh) of reading it. Whoever reads it in the accusative (naṣb) does so as praise (madḥ) of Allah, Mighty and Majestic; whoever reads it in the nominative (rafʿ) also does so as praise, in the sense of "He is the Lord of Might (هو رَبُّ العِزَّةِ)"; and whoever reads it in the genitive (khafḍ) does so following His saying "رَبِّكَ رَبِّ العِزَّةِ". The accusative may also be [understood as] "I mean the Lord of Might (أعْنِي رَبَّ العِزَّةِ)" and "I mention the Lord of Might (أذْكُرُ رَبَّ العِزَّةِ)".

zajjaj:1-1.t:
Sūrat al-Ṣāffāt
﷽
His saying — Mighty and Majestic is He —: ﴿والصّافّاتِ صَفًّا﴾ ("by those ranged in ranks"). Most readers pronounce the tāʾ distinctly, and it has also been read with assimilation of the tāʾ into the ṣād. Likewise ﴿فالزّاجِراتِ زَجْرًا﴾ [al-Ṣāffāt: 2] ("and those who drive with a driving"): if you wish you assimilate the tāʾ into the zāy, and if you wish you pronounce it distinctly; and likewise ﴿فالتّالِياتِ ذِكْرًا﴾ [al-Ṣāffāt: 3] ("and those who recite a Reminder").
﴿إنَّ إلَهَكم لَواحِدٌ﴾ [al-Ṣāffāt: 4] ("your God is indeed One"): He — Mighty and Majestic is He — swore by these things that He is One. It has also been said that its meaning is: "by the Lord of these things, He is One". The interpretation of “اَلصّافّاتِ” is that they are the angels, that is: they are obedient in heaven, glorifying Allah — Mighty and Majestic is He. “فالزّاجِراتِ”: it is related that the angels drive the clouds; and it has been said: “فالزّاجِراتِ زَجْرًا” is everything that restrains from disobedience to Allah. ﴿فالتّالِياتِ ذِكْرًا﴾ [al-Ṣāffāt: 3]: it has been said: "the angels"; and it is possible that it is the angels and others as well, among those who recite the remembrance of Allah.
﴿وَرَبُّ المَشارِقِ﴾ [al-Ṣāffāt: 5] ("and Lord of the points of sunrise"), and the points of sunset. It has been said: the points of sunrise are three hundred and sixty, and likewise the points of sunset.

zajjaj:6-6.t: ﴿إنّا زَيَّنّا السَّماءَ الدُّنْيا بِزِينَةٍ الكَواكِبِ﴾ ("We have adorned the lowest heaven with an adornment, the stars"), [read] with “زِينَة” in iḍāfa (genitive construct) to “اَلْكَواكِبِ” [i.e. بِزِينَةِ الكَواكِبِ, "with the adornment of the stars"], and most readers read it this way. It has also been read with tanwīn and the genitive of “الكَواكِبِ”, the meaning being that “اَلْكَواكِبِ” is a badal (substitute) for “الزِّينَة”; the meaning is: "We have adorned the lowest heaven with the stars". “بِزِينَةٍ الكَواكِبَ” is also permissible — and it is the least common in reading — in the sense: "by Our adorning the stars"; and it is possible that “اَلْكَواكِبِ” in the accusative is a badal for His saying “بِزِينَةٍ”, because “بِزِينَةٍ” is in the position of an accusative. “بِزِينَةٍ الكَواكِبُ” is also permissible, but I do not know anyone who read it so; so do not read it so unless a transmission of it is established, because reading is a sunna (followed practice). The nominative of “اَلْكَواكِبُ” is in the sense: "We have adorned the lowest heaven in that its adornment is the stars", and "in that the stars have been adorned".

zajjaj:7-7.t: And His saying: ﴿وَحِفْظًا مِن كُلِّ شَيْطانٍ مارِدٍ﴾ ("and as protection against every rebellious devil"), in the sense: "and We protected it with a protection from every rebellious devil"; they are pelted with them [the stars] when they try to eavesdrop.

zajjaj:8-8.t:
“لا يَسْمَعُونَ إلى المَلَإ الأعْلى” ("they cannot listen to the exalted assembly"); it is also read with shadda: “يَسَّمَّعُونَ”, in the sense of “يَتَسَمَّعُونَ” ("they strain to listen").
﴿وَيُقْذَفُونَ مِن كُلِّ جانِبٍ﴾ ﴿دُحُورًا﴾ [al-Ṣāffāt: 9] ("and they are pelted from every side, repelled"), that is: they are driven off, that is: they are kept far away. ﴿وَلَهم عَذابٌ واصِبٌ﴾ [al-Ṣāffāt: 9] ("and theirs is a wāṣib punishment"): it has been said: "constant", and it has been said: "painful".

zajjaj:10-10.t:
﴿إلا مَن خَطِفَ﴾ ("except one who snatches [a word]"), with fatḥa and kasra on the ṭāʾ; one says: “خَطِفْتُ، أخْطَفُ” and “خَطَفْتُ أخْطِفُ”, when I take a thing quickly. “إلّا مَن خَطَّفَ”, with shadda on the ṭāʾ and fatḥa on the khāʾ, is also permissible; and “خِطَّفَ”, with kasra on the khāʾ and fatḥa on the ṭāʾ, is permissible. The meaning is “اِخْتَطَفَ”: the tāʾ was assimilated into the ṭāʾ, and the alif dropped because the khāʾ now had a vowel. Whoever gives the khāʾ fatḥa casts onto it the fatḥa of the tāʾ which was in “اِخْتَطَفَ”; and whoever gives it kasra does so because of its quiescence and the quiescence of the ṭāʾ. As for whoever transmitted “خِطِفَ الخَطْفَةَ”, with kasra on the khāʾ and the ṭāʾ, it has no justification except a very weak one: that the ṭāʾ is made to follow the kasra of the khāʾ (itbāʿ).
﴿فَأتْبَعَهُ شِهابٌ ثاقِبٌ﴾ ("and a piercing flame pursues him"): one says “تَبِعْتُهُ”, “أتْبَعْتُهُ” and “اِتَّبَعْتُهُ”, when I go on his track. “شِهابٌ ثاقِبٌ” is a shining star.

zajjaj:11-11.t:
﴿فاسْتَفْتِهِمْ﴾ ("so ask them"), that is: ask them a question that makes them acknowledge: ﴿أهم أشَدُّ خَلْقًا أمْ مَن خَلَقْنا﴾ ("are they stronger in creation, or those whom We have created?") — of the bygone nations before them, and others besides them, of the heavens and the earths?!
﴿مِن طِينٍ لازِبٍ﴾ ("from sticky clay"), and “لازِمٍ”; the meaning of both is one, that is: “لازِقٍ” ("adhesive").
